description: This file defines the ProductPurchased controller class for the Opencart admin report extension, handling report display, saving settings, and generating product purchase reports.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for managing the product purchased report in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the product purchased report form with current settings and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST request, with permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the product purchased report list with data and order statuses.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the product purchased report list based on filters and pagination.
